faqItems.question: How long does Invisalign take compared to braces?
faqItems.answer: Treatment times vary by case complexity, but many patients achieve their goal in 12-18 months. During your free consultation, Dr. Galea will provide a specific timeline for your smile.

faqItems.question: How much does Invisalign cost, and is it covered by insurance?
faqItems.answer: We accept many insurance plans and offer the Smile Squad Plan for significant savings. We also provide flexible financing to make clear aligners affordable for any budget.

faqItems.question: How many hours a day do I have to wear my aligners?
faqItems.answer: For optimal results, you should wear your Invisalign aligners for 20 to 22 hours a day, removing them only to eat, drink, brush, and floss.

faqItems.question: Can Invisalign fix my specific bite issue?
faqItems.answer: Invisalign is highly effective for crowding, spacing, overbites, and underbites. Dr. Galea will use our advanced technology to determine if you are a candidate.

faqItems.question: Will Invisalign hurt or affect my speech?
faqItems.answer: Most patients experience minor pressure when starting a new set of aligners. Any slight lisp usually disappears within a few days as your tongue adjusts.

faqItems.question: What happens after treatment — do I need a retainer?
faqItems.answer: To maintain your new alignment, we provide custom retainers. Wearing them as directed ensures your teeth stay in their ideal position for life.

doctor.name: James Galea
doctor.bio: Dr. James Galea is the lead orthodontist at Brewer Dental Center, dedicated to helping patients of all ages achieve healthy, confident smiles. He specializes in bite correction and modern orthodontic solutions, including Invisalign and clear aligner therapy. Dr. Galea focuses on a patient-first philosophy, offering complimentary consultations to ensure families understand their options. He works within a collaborative team environment to deliver tailored treatments that meet the unique needs of every patient.
